source_lines_after.38: Assume full AC. For every closed oriented 3-manifold $M$ there exists a finite constant $C_M$ such that for every discrete group $\Gamma$ and every homomorphism $\phi:\pi_1(M)\to\Gamma$ for which the rho invariant is defined, $|\rho(M,\phi)|\le C_M$. The constant may depend on $M$ but not on $\Gamma$ or $\phi$.
